1
Mild Microcytic/Normocytic Anemia: Hemoglobin (10.8 g/dL) and Hematocrit (32.4%) are mildly reduced. Suggestive of early iron
deficiency anemia or anemia of chronic disease. Serum Ferritin; Iron; and TIBC studies are recommended for clinical correlation:

physical stress. No immature granulocytes or blasts identified on blood smear examination.
